app.name: Quickmock
app.tagline: Spin up an HTTP mock endpoint in 30 seconds.
home.hero.title: Create a mock API in 30 seconds
home.hero.subtitle: Paste a response. Pick a status code. Get a URL. No signup.
home.security.title: Don't paste real secrets
home.security.body: Mocks are public — anyone with the URL can read the response body. Never put real API keys, access tokens, passwords, or production data into a mock.
home.privacy.badge: No trackers · No analytics · No accounts
home.privacy.title: What we don't do
home.privacy.body: No third-party analytics. No tracking pixels. No fingerprinting. No external JS or fonts. No ads. No accounts, no email, no data sold or shared.
home.privacy.what_we_log.title: What we do log (and why)
home.privacy.what_we_log.item1: Your IP for rate limiting — kept for 8 hours in Redis, then dropped.
home.privacy.what_we_log.item2: The IP that created a mock — to enforce the 50-mocks-per-IP limit. Never shown in the UI.
home.privacy.what_we_log.item3: Requests to your mocks — that's the inspector feature. You can clear them any time, and they disappear when the mock expires.
home.privacy.what_we_log.item4: Your language preference, in a cookie. That's it for cookies.
home.howto.title: How it works
home.howto.step1: Fill out the form below — method, response body, status code.
home.howto.step2: Click "Create Mock" and you'll get a public URL like /m/abc123.
home.howto.step3: Use the URL in your code. Open the mock page to watch requests live.
mock.create.title: Create Mock Endpoint
mock.create.name: Name (optional)
mock.create.path_suffix_hint: Optional. Adds a readable label after the slug — your URL becomes /m/<slug>/users/123. Any path under /m/<slug>/* still hits this mock, so it's a hint for humans, not a constraint. Letters, digits, dashes, dots, underscores, slashes; up to 255 characters.
mock.create.path_suffix_invalid: Path may contain letters, digits, `-`, `.`, `_`, `~` and `/`. No spaces or special characters.
mock.create.beautify_error: Cannot beautify — body isn't valid JSON.
mock.detail.title: Mock Endpoint
mock.detail.delete_confirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
mock.curl_import.title: Import from cURL
mock.curl_import.hint: Paste a cURL command — we'll pre-fill the method, body, and Content-Type.
mock.curl_import.error: Couldn't parse that cURL command. Make sure it starts with `curl`.
share.title: Read-only preview
share.body: This is a public preview of a mock endpoint. Anyone with this link can view the response and example calls, but cannot edit or see request logs.
share.og.description: Mock HTTP endpoint — try it instantly with cURL or your code.
mock.logs.title: Request Log
mock.logs.subtitle: Last %d requests, updated live.
mock.logs.empty: No requests yet. Hit the URL above to see them appear here.
mock.logs.clear_confirm: Clear all logs for this mock?
mocks.list.title: My Mocks
mocks.list.empty.title: No mocks yet
mocks.list.empty.body: Mocks you create in this browser will appear here.
errors.rate_limit: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errors.mock_limit_reached: You've reached the limit of %d active mocks from this address.
